## 🙋 FAQ

- Q: **_"What file formats are available?"_**\
  A: Currently, the available file formats are `ASE`, `ASEPRITE`, `BMP`, `CSS`, `FLC`, `FLI`, `JPEG`, `JPG`, `PCX`, `PCC`, `PNG`, `QOI`, `TGA`, and `WEBP`.

## Usage

1. Download the flags in your flavor of your choice.
2. Enjoy!
